{{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS292 |prevtitle=Bested by Banette |nextcode=PS294 |nexttitle=Mewtwo and Mew Too |series=FireRed & LeafGreen |colorscheme=FRLG}} {{ChapInfobox |title_en=Down-for-the-Count Deoxys |subtitle=Aurora Illusion |title_ja=まやかしのオーロラ |title_ro=The Fake Aurora |image=PS293.png |scheme=FireRed & LeafGreen |pub1=Shogakukan full volume |pub1-data=Chapter 293 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|25}} |pub2=VIZ Media full volume |pub2-data=Adventure 293 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|25}} |location=[[Team Rocket airship]] }} '''Down-for-the-Count Deoxys''' is the 293rd chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 26th chapter of the {{MangaArc|FireRed & LeafGreen}}. It is subtitled '''Aurora Illusion''' (Japanese: '''まやかしのオーロラ''' ''The Fake Aurora'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{adv|Mewtwo}} successfully spears {{adv|Deoxys}} in the chest with a spoon-shaped psychic energy attack. Deoxys quickly shifts between its Attack, Defense, and Speed Formes as it tries to clench its chest. {{adv|Giovanni}} assumes that {{adv|Red}}'s statement about not having a plan was nothing more than a trick. Mewtwo tells Giovanni that he's wrong, and that it simply followed Red's instructions to hit Deoxys's core by any means possible. Mewtwo states that its style is trusting its master no matter the circumstances. Mewtwo claims victory, as Deoxys can't control itself. Red notes that [[Pika]] is trying to remind him that when it hit Deoxys with {{m|Thunder}}, Deoxys used {{m|Recover}} to heal itself and attacked with {{m|Psycho Boost}}. Mewtwo decides to just attack again and prevent Deoxys from healing itself with Recover. Mewtwo reveals that its attack didn't just have the one blast and has several more blasts of energy shoot down from the sky. Giovanni tells Deoxys to turn into its Defense Forme, but it is unable to change and simply takes the attack in its Normal Forme. With Deoxys took weak to change, Mewtwo brandishes its spoon and rushes in to attack. Red tells it to be careful, but Mewtwo states that it has figured out Forme Change's weakness. Mewtwo continues attacking furiously, but Deoxys manages to barely block the attacks. Deoxys is knocked into a wall, so Mewtwo goes in for the finish. Just before it can strike, Mewtwo is pierced in the back by two tentacles. Mewtwo notices that the tentacles are from its Attack Forme, yet Deoxys is currently in its Normal Forme. Deoxys reveals that it was using an aurora to make it appear to be in its Normal Forme, when it was really in its Attack Forme the whole time. Giovanni notes that it was too close, but Deoxys has managed to use Recover in time. Giovanni states that Red and Mewtwo are the strongest opponents he has ever faced, so he will let them witness the strongest move in Deoxys's arsenal: Psycho Boost. Outside the [[Team Rocket airship]], {{adv|Yellow}} sends out [[Ratty]] and has him chew an opening. Yellow enters the ship and quickly begins looking for {{adv|Silver}}. Elsewhere, [[Sird]] and [[Orm]] take the unconscious Silver to a room. Orm notes that Yellow has arrived, but Sird tells him to ignore her for now. Sird decides that Silver's current attire is too unsuitable and decides to give him a new set of clothes. She puts a jacket over Silver's clothes and claims that he will be [[Team Rocket]]'s prince of darkness. ==Major events== * {{adv|Red}} and {{adv|Mewtwo}} continue their battle against {{adv|Giovanni}} and {{adv|Deoxys}}. * {{adv|Yellow}} enters the airship. * [[Sird]] dresses {{adv|Silver}} in a [[Team Rocket]] uniform. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Red}} * {{adv|Yellow}} * {{adv|Silver}} * {{adv|Giovanni}} * [[Sird]] * [[Orm]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Pikachu}} ([[Pika]]; {{adv|Red}}'s) * {{p|Raticate}} ([[Ratty]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Butterfree}} ([[Kitty]]/{{tt|Freesk|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Deoxys}} ({{adv|Deoxys|Adventures}}; {{DL|Deoxys (Adventures)|Organism No. 2}}/{{tt|Entity Two|Chuang Yi}}; {{form|Deoxys|all Formes}}; {{adv|Giovanni}}'s) * {{p|Banette}} ([[Sird]]'s) * {{p|Mewtwo}} ({{adv|Mewtwo|Adventures}}) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{colorschemelight|FRLG}}|bordercolor={{colorschemedark|FRLG}} |zh_yue={{tt|虛幻的極光|Unreal Aurora}} |zh_cmn={{tt|詭異的光芒|Weird light}} (Taiwan)
